Class Transaction

java.lang.Object
library.model.Transaction
public class Transaction extends Object
Represents a transaction record in the library system. Each transaction logs an operation performed on a book or member, including the timestamp, type, involved IDs, performer, and details.
Author:
Usman

      type - the type of transaction
      bookId - the book ID involved (empty if not applicable)
